opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK; projects led by individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with a UK institution, schools, colleges, undergraduates, PhD students, or non‑UK organisations are excluded. In exceptional cases, overseas organisations may apply if no UK host is feasible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation’s five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Grants of up to £500,000 (up to £750,000 in special cases) are available.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities in the UK. Partnerships are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and contributing to understanding, public debate, policy and practice on tackling racial inequalities.
